audit_metadata.name: Lady D Trilogy Independent Pre-Rewrite Manuscript Audit

scope.grain: One devotional entry and one companion-journal reflection per volume/day, plus one February 29 bonus per volume.

concurrent_artifact_boundary.reason: These undeclared revised-reader candidates appeared outside the canonical pre-rewrite assembly manifest. Mixing them into the baseline would invalidate before/after comparison. They require a separate post-rewrite judge and auditor pass and receive no release approval here.

methodology.source_of_truth: Source lists declared in downloads/production/master/master-assembly-audit.json; assembled Markdown masters used for reconciliation, not double-counting.
checks: Reference syntax, recognized book, and chapter range
Field-label contract, prayer, and prompt completeness
Exact normalized sentence repetition, within-entry duplication, and title-masked near-exact templates
Exact/near-duplicate titles and exact reference reuse
Bible-book run length, adjacency, monotonicity, and monthly concentration
Journal coverage, prompt/practice completeness, style consistency, prayer/review sections, and response-space markup
limitations: No verse text exists in the entries, so exact KJV/NKJV concordance cannot yet be performed.
Structural original-language signals do not establish lexical or theological accuracy; qualified human review is required.
Markdown response-space detection does not replace visual inspection of final 6x9 PDF interiors and printed proofs.
Near-duplicate title detection uses SequenceMatcher >= 0.90 within each volume; it is a screening test, not a literary verdict.

findings.failure: Required visible Scripture text is absent from the devotional entries.
findings.evidence: 1098 of 1,098 entries lack a visible, translation-tagged Scripture text block; 0 contain one.
findings.impact: Readers cannot see the passage being interpreted, and context-language claims cannot be checked on the page.
findings.likely_cause: The sources preserve a pre-permissions placeholder policy that conflicts with the July 6 direction.
findings.remediation: Insert verified KJV text or properly licensed NKJV text with a translation tag in every entry, then run text-reference concordance and rights checks.

findings.failure: The revised daily-entry contract from July 6 has not been implemented.
findings.evidence: All 1,098 entries retain both Today step and Morning impact instead of the requested fused reflection/action ending.
findings.impact: The pages remain crowded and formulaic, leaving less room for the fuller, more impactful devotional narrative requested by the author.
findings.likely_cause: The assembled masters still reflect the earlier production schema.
findings.remediation: Rewrite to one locked entry contract and remove both deprecated labels from the revised masters.

findings.failure: Scripture selection remains heavily clustered in long, sequential Bible-book runs.
findings.evidence: V1: longest run 178 days in Genesis, 97.0% adjacent same-book transitions; V2: longest run 191 days in Matthew, 97.2% adjacent same-book transitions; V3: longest run 96 days in Judges, 95.3% adjacent same-book transitions
findings.impact: The reader experiences the mechanical Bible-order crawl the July 6 guidance explicitly rejected.
findings.likely_cause: References were allocated in book-order production batches rather than curated as a thematic reading journey.
findings.remediation: Re-sequence within monthly themes using diversity constraints and a human-reviewed narrative arc.

findings.failure: Formula reuse and duplicated sentences create an automated-production voice.
findings.evidence: 44 exact repeated sentence groups, 9 title-masked near-exact template groups, and 28 within-entry duplicate sentence instances.
findings.impact: Repetition weakens Lady D's personal voice and the requested emotional impact.
findings.likely_cause: Reusable transition and impact-line templates were applied at scale.
findings.remediation: Rewrite repeated frames, remove within-entry duplicates, and enforce a corpus-level phrase-reuse gate with a small approved liturgical whitelist.

findings.failure: Calendar-bound 2026/Saturday language makes the evergreen devotional edition date-specific.
findings.evidence: 148 devotional entries and 140 journal entries contain strict 2026/Saturday-bound wording or headings.
findings.impact: The day/date sequence will assert the wrong weekday in other years and makes Sabbath reflections look mechanically assigned from the 2026 calendar.
findings.likely_cause: Saturday flags were generated from the 2026 production calendar.
findings.remediation: Remove year/weekday assertions; preserve Sabbath theology through evergreen thematic placement and author-approved wording.

findings.failure: The Context and language lens frequently behaves as editorial scaffolding rather than concise reader-facing language insight.
findings.evidence: 569 entries contain explicit lens/meta framing; 612 have no deterministic original-language signal.
findings.impact: The feature can feel technical, generic, or disconnected, especially because the Scripture text it should illuminate is missing.
findings.likely_cause: Context explanation and original-language study were combined under one label without a locked quality rubric.
findings.remediation: Keep the lens only where it adds verified meaning; require qualified lexical review and remove all editorial/meta phrasing.

findings.failure: Companion-journal content coverage exists, but the journal source is not a finished reader-writing product.
findings.evidence: All 1,098 reflections have prompts/practices, but only 0 of 165 journal sources contain detectable response-space markup; style shifts between structured Focus/Write/Practice and direct question/Practice formats.
findings.impact: The journal is content-complete but not layout-complete or contract-consistent for KDP release.
findings.likely_cause: Journal masters were assembled before trim-specific design and human-touch layout work.
findings.remediation: Lock one journal contract, add intentional writing space and weekly/monthly rhythm, then proof at final trim size.

findings.failure: Titles and Scripture references need duplicate/near-duplicate editorial review.
findings.evidence: Corpus duplicate titles: 1 groups; duplicate references: 82 groups; near-duplicate title pairs at >=90% similarity: 79.
findings.impact: Repeated naming and passages can make the year feel less intentionally composed even when individual entries differ.
findings.likely_cause: Title-generation formulas and separate volume production lanes were not reconciled at trilogy scale.
findings.remediation: Review duplicate groups in context and require rationale for any intentional reuse.

findings.failure: Internal review/production language remains in source and master front matter, with additional meta language inside entries.
findings.evidence: Every production batch carries production/editorial permission notes; entry-level counts are detailed by volume in this report.
findings.impact: Internal scaffolding can leak into customer-facing or KDP-ready outputs and reduces the sense of a finished book.
findings.likely_cause: Review masters were promoted before a clean publication-layer transform.
findings.remediation: Create a publication master with zero internal notes and enforce a forbidden-phrase test.

acceptance_tests.name: Corpus grain
acceptance_tests.test: Each volume contains Day 001-365 exactly once plus one February 29 bonus; no missing or duplicate keys in source or master.

acceptance_tests.name: Visible Scripture
acceptance_tests.test: Every entry contains the full quoted passage, a KJV/NKJV tag, and a reference that concords with the displayed text.

acceptance_tests.name: Scripture rights
acceptance_tests.test: KJV public-domain/territory policy or NKJV license/quotation limits are documented for print, ebook, web, and audio.
acceptance_tests.threshold: Signed publishing-rights checklist before layout lock.

acceptance_tests.name: Revised entry contract
acceptance_tests.test: Entry contains date/title, visible Scripture, opening hook, fuller devotional body, optional verified meaning lens, prayer, and one fused reflection/action ending.
acceptance_tests.threshold: 100% contract coverage; 0 Today step labels; 0 Morning impact labels.

acceptance_tests.name: Prayer and prompt
acceptance_tests.test: Every entry has a substantive prayer and a clear reader-facing reflection/action prompt tied to the passage.
acceptance_tests.threshold: 1,098/1,098 present; 0 placeholders; 0 empty or fragmentary fields.

acceptance_tests.name: Phrase originality
acceptance_tests.test: Scan sentences of eight or more words after normalization and title masking.
acceptance_tests.threshold: 0 within-entry duplicate sentences; no unapproved sentence/template in more than 3 entries; approved refrains documented.

acceptance_tests.name: Scripture journey
acceptance_tests.test: Measure same-book runs, monthly book diversity, and adjacent same-book rate after re-sequencing.
acceptance_tests.threshold: No undocumented run over 7 days; no month over 40% one book; at least 4 Bible books per month; adjacent same-book rate <=35%.

acceptance_tests.name: Evergreen dating
acceptance_tests.test: Search devotional and journal sources for production year and weekday-bound claims.
acceptance_tests.threshold: 0 occurrences of production-calendar/2026 wording; 0 Saturday/Sunday claims tied to fixed dates.

acceptance_tests.name: Context-language quality
acceptance_tests.test: Any retained lens is concise, passage-specific, reader-facing, and reviewed against the displayed verse by a qualified biblical-language/theology reviewer.
acceptance_tests.threshold: 0 editorial-meta lenses; 100% retained lenses signed off; optional omission preferred over weak filler.

acceptance_tests.name: Title/reference duplication
acceptance_tests.test: Exact and >=90% near-duplicate titles plus repeated references are reviewed in trilogy context.
acceptance_tests.threshold: 0 accidental duplicate titles; every repeated reference has documented thematic rationale and distinct treatment.

acceptance_tests.name: Journal coverage
acceptance_tests.test: Each devotional entry maps one-to-one to a journal reflection with a clear prompt and practice.
acceptance_tests.threshold: 366/366 per volume; 0 missing/duplicate mappings; 0 empty prompt/practice fields.

acceptance_tests.name: Journal product design
acceptance_tests.test: Final 6x9 journal masters use one approved hierarchy, adequate response space, weekly prayer/review rhythm, and legible trim-safe margins.
acceptance_tests.threshold: 100% page-template conformance; KDP Previewer and printed-proof approval.

acceptance_tests.name: Publication language
acceptance_tests.test: Search publication masters for production, editorial, permissions, model, prompt, reader-instruction scaffolding, and placeholder language.

acceptance_tests.name: Master/source integrity
acceptance_tests.test: Rebuild masters from the declared source inventory and compare normalized entry signatures and hashes.
acceptance_tests.threshold: 0 missing entries; 0 content mismatches; manifest and checksums archived.

acceptance_tests.name: Scripture glossary
acceptance_tests.test: Generate biblical-order glossary entries linking reference to day/date and final page after pagination lock.
acceptance_tests.threshold: 1,098 source entries represented; 0 broken day/page mappings.

acceptance_tests.name: Independent release gate
acceptance_tests.test: A second auditor samples all flagged categories and verifies automated counts after rewrite; author reviews representative months and final proofs.
acceptance_tests.threshold: No Critical/High findings open; signed author/editor/auditor approvals; physical proof approved.

release_decision.reason: Critical and High manuscript-contract failures remain. This audit establishes the rewrite baseline only.
